subtitle: Monthly horror picks for the mortally curious.
vote_instructions: Vote for your favorite novel and short story.

novels.title: Between Two Fires
novels.author: Christopher Buehlman (2012)
novels.vibe: Medieval Black Death horror where a disgraced knight and a mysterious girl walk straight into a war between Heaven and Hell.
novels.summary: As the plague ravages 14th-century France, a disillusioned knight named Thomas falls in with Delphine, a peasant girl who claims to speak with angels — right as Lucifer makes his move to finish a war against Heaven. The novel pairs historical grimness (plague, famine, religious violence) with outright apocalyptic horror as the two travel toward Avignon.
novels.warnings: Sexual assault and threat of sexual assault involving minors, child endangerment, torture, extreme body horror, religious violence, antisemitism, anti-gay bigotry, alcohol addiction.

novels.title: When the Wolf Comes Home
novels.author: Nat Cassidy (2025)
novels.vibe: A blood-soaked, fast-moving werewolf chase novel about a woman, a runaway kid, and the thing hunting them both.
novels.summary: Jessa's rough night at the diner turns into something far worse when she finds a terrified runaway boy outside, followed almost immediately by a violent encounter with his father. As they flee together, Jessa slowly realizes the boy's fear itself is manifesting into monstrous, bloody reality behind them.
novels.warnings: Graphic violence and gore, child endangerment, abuse, alcoholism, parent death, self-harm, kidnapping, body horror.

novels.title: The Exorcist
novels.author: William Peter Blatty (1971)
novels.vibe: The classic possession novel that defined the genre — a mother's search for answers as her daughter's body and mind are taken over by something ancient.
novels.summary: When young Regan begins exhibiting terrifying, inexplicable behavior, her mother exhausts every medical explanation before turning to the Church for help. Two priests are drawn into a brutal, escalating exorcism that tests their faith as much as it endangers their lives, in the novel that inspired the landmark film.
novels.warnings: Graphic violence against a child, blasphemy/religious desecration, disturbing sexual content, profanity, body horror.

novels.title: The Troop
novels.author: Nick Cutter (2014)
novels.vibe: Lord of the Flies with parasitic worms and no safety rails.
novels.summary: A scoutmaster takes a small troop of boys on a routine camping trip to a remote Canadian island, only to have a starving, infected stranger stagger into camp. Once the parasite spreads, the story turns into a brutally graphic survival nightmare as hunger, infection, and cruelty strip away any veneer of civility.
novels.warnings: Extreme gore, body horror, animal death, starvation, bullying, child endangerment.

short_works.title: A Short Stay in Hell
short_works.author: Steven L. Peck (2011)
short_works.vibe: A devout Mormon geologist dies and wakes up in a Hell that punishes him with an incomprehensibly vast library instead of fire.
short_works.summary: Soren Johansson dies expecting to reunite with his family in the afterlife, and instead finds himself condemned by an unfamiliar god to a Hell built as an endless library. His only way out is to find the one book, among an effectively infinite number, that tells the true story of his life — a existential, slow-building horror about eternity and futility rather than gore.
short_works.warnings: Existential dread, themes of eternal suffering and futility, brief violence, death of loved ones (referenced).

short_works.title: Cabal
short_works.author: Clive Barker (1988)
short_works.vibe: A monstrous found-family horror novella where the real killers turn out to be entirely human.
short_works.summary: Boone, convinced by his manipulative therapist that he's a serial killer, turns himself in and learns of Midian, a hidden refuge for shape-shifting creatures called the Nightbreed. As Boone is drawn into Midian and its inhabitants, the story flips expectations about who the real monsters are, building to a bloody confrontation with the humans hunting the Nightbreed down.
short_works.warnings: Graphic violence and gore, body horror, mass murder, psychological manipulation, mob violence.

short_works.title: Carmilla
short_works.author: Sheridan Le Fanu (1872)
short_works.vibe: The original lesbian vampire novella, predating Dracula by decades and dripping with gothic sexual tension.
short_works.summary: Isolated in a remote Austrian castle, Laura is captivated by Carmilla, a strange and beautiful young guest who arrives after a carriage accident. As their intense friendship deepens, Laura grows increasingly ill and haunted by nightmares, slowly realizing what — and who — Carmilla really is.
short_works.warnings: Vampirism/blood-drinking, death, illness, predatory undertones, period-typical treatment of female sexuality and class.
